(async()=>{const A=await import('/js/flight/aircraft.js'), THREE=await import('three'); const AC=A.AC; AC.group.position.set(0,0,0); AC.group.rotation.set(0,0,0); AC.group.updateMatrixWorld(true); const inv=AC.group.matrixWorld.clone().invert(); const P=[]; const v=new THREE.Vector3(); AC.ext.traverse(o=>{ if(!o.isMesh) return; const a=o.geometry.attributes.position; const step=Math.max(1, Math.floor(a.count/400)); for(let i=0;i<a.count;i+=step){ v.fromBufferAttribute(a,i).applyMatrix4(o.matrixWorld).applyMatrix4(inv); P.push([v.x,v.y,v.z]); } }); let mx=[1e9,1e9,1e9], Mx=[-1e9,-1e9,-1e9], c=[0,0,0]; for(const p of P){ for(let k=0;k<3;k++){ mx[k]=Math.min(mx[k],p[k]); Mx[k]=Math.max(Mx[k],p[k]); c[k]+=p[k]/P.length; } } let sxx=0,szz=0,sxz=0; for(const p of P){ const dx=p[0]-c[0], dz=p[2]-c[2]; sxx+=dx*dx; szz+=dz*dz; sxz+=dx*dz; } const ang=0.5*Math.atan2(2*sxz, sxx-szz)*180/Math.PI; const zs=P.map(p=>p[2]).sort((a,b)=>a-b); const tallZ = P.filter(p=>p[1] > Mx[1]-1.5).map(p=>p[2]); const tailZ = tallZ.reduce((a,b)=>a+b,0)/tallZ.length; return JSON.stringify({n:P.length, min:mx.map(x=>+x.toFixed(1)), max:Mx.map(x=>+x.toFixed(1)), centroid:c.map(x=>+x.toFixed(1)), pcaAngleFromX:+ang.toFixed(1), finTopZ:+tailZ.toFixed(1)})})()
